title: Woo-verzoek
description: The flow of the Woo request case type, which register.d/81-woo-verzoek.json seeds. Each move asks what its step needs: documents gathered before they are assessed, every document assessed before redaction and the decision, a decision before publication, and the publication before the case closes. Installed on every install and upgrade. The case type names this flow as its default route, so a new Woo request follows it; a case already bound to another flow keeps that one.
